'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Twelve-Day War]]
***[[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War#Operation Rising Lion|Airstrikes during the Twelve-Day War]]
****[[Israel]] continues to launch [[airstrike]]s on [[Iran]] while Iran launches a wave of [[ballistic missile]]s at Israel despite the [[United States]] claiming a [[Iran–Israel war ceasefire|ceasefire]] had been reached between the warring sides. [https://aje.io/7jaly7 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/jun/24/israel-iran-war-live-updates-trump-declares-ceasefire-tehran-attack-us-base-qatar?CMP=share_btn_url&page=with%3Ablock-685a08ba8f087a952d11a347#block-685a08ba8f087a952d11a347 (''The Guardian'')]
****Nine people are killed in an Israeli airstrike on [[residential]] units in [[Gilan]], Iran. The attack also injured 33 people, including 16 women and children, with five requiring hospital treatment. [https://aje.io/7jaly7?update=3796482 (Al Jazeera)]
****Four people are killed and 22 others are injured in [[Beersheba]], [[Southern District (Israel)|Southern Israel]], after an Iranian missile strikes an [[apartment]] block. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/4-killed-in-beersheba-as-iran-fires-multiple-missile-salvos-just-before-ceasefire/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] tells reporters at the [[White House]] that Israel and Iran "don't know what the fuck they are doing" as both countries continue to launch attacks despite U.S. claims of a ceasefire. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn7ze4vmk2pt (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-iran-israel-what-theyre-doing-b2775841.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jun/24/trump-israel-iran-ceasefire-netanyahu (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
****At least 44 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israeli defence forces|Israeli forces]] who open fire towards people waiting for [[humanitarian aid|aid]] trucks in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-06-24-2025-dbbdba6c1986376e6e09900650814412 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch an [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander]] missile strike on [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least 19 people and injuring 300 others. Another two [[civilian]]s are killed and nine others are injured in [[Samar, Ukraine|Samar]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]] as a result of a Russian air attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-attack-kills-nine-damages-passenger-train-southeast-ukraine-2025-06-24/ (Reuters)] [https://kyivindependent.com/russia-strikes-dnipro-with-ballistic-missiles-hits-civilian-train06-2025/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/06/24/7518465/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[Human Rights Watch]] reports that at least 120 children have been abducted by [[Islamic State]]-linked [[Al-Shabaab (Mozambique)|Ansar al-Sunna]] insurgents in [[Cabo Delgado Province]], [[Mozambique]], this year. The children are used for [[child labor|labor]], conscripted as [[child soldier]]s, or [[child marriage|forced into marriage]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mozambique-shabab-insurgents-child-kidnap-ebb0df840676355f7e261d132ec49d91 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Germany|German]] [[Federal Ministry of Finance (Germany)|finance minister]] [[Lars Klingbeil]] announces that the [[German government]] will raise its [[defense budget]] from 2.4% to 3.5% of its [[GDP]] by 2029, citing a [[NATO]] quota for member states to raise defense spending. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-defense-spending-budget-nato-169e869922af3d349329ac1a921e634d (AP)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/friedrich-merz-germany-major-nato-defense-boost-donald-trump-us-eu-military-budget-ukraine-russia/ (''Politico'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The death toll from a boat accident from a storm on [[Lake Tahoe]] in the [[Sierra Nevada]] mountains of the United States increases to eight as the final missing person is recovered. [https://www.npr.org/2025/06/24/nx-s1-5442739/last-body-found-boat-capsizes-lake-tahoe-storm-death-toll-8 (NPR)]
*Twenty people are injured, including 12 children, after lightning strikes near [[Lake Murray (South Carolina)|Lake Murray]] in the U.S. state of [[South Carolina]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/20-injured-in-lightning-strike-at-south-carolina-beach/ar-AA1Hm52u?ocid=BingNewsSerp (MSN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Irapuato shooting]]
**At least 11 people are killed, including a teenager, and 20 others are injured when gunmen open fire at a party celebrating the [[Nativity of John the Baptist]] in [[Irapuato]], [[Guanajuato]], Mexico. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/least-10-killed-home-shooting-central-mexico-2025-06-25/ (Reuters)]
*Three soldiers are killed and eight others are injured when a soldier opens fire on his colleagues during an altercation over [[paycheck]]s in Mungazi, [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of Congo]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/congolese-soldier-kills-3-colleagues-during-altercation-in-the-conflict-hit-east/ (CTV News)]
*[[Law enforcement in France|French police]] detain 12 people after over 145 people report being stabbed with [[syringe]]s at [[Fête de la Musique]] sites across [[France|the country]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-145-festivalgoers-jabbed-with-syringes/a-73012961 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 New York City Democratic mayoral primary]]
**[[Zohran Mamdani]] leads the [[Primary election|primary]] to become the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] nominee for the [[2025 New York City mayoral election]], defeating former [[governor of New York]] [[Andrew Cuomo]], with Mamdani having received 43.5% of first-choice votes. He is the presumptive nominee, however the official winner will be declared after the ranked choice tally on July 1. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2025/06/24/nyc-mayoral-democratic-primary-cuomo-mamdani/84292986007/ (''USA Today'')]
